blocks.html: MSW = 3.14, df = 21. Exact studentized-range probabilities. Tukey HSD assumes similar spread in every group; with unequal spreads use Welch ANOVA, which comes with Games-Howell.

No Shapiro-Wilk p is below .05, so nothing here argues against normality. That is weaker evidence than it sounds when groups are small. With fewer than 20 values these tests have little power and miss real departures; with several hundred they flag differences too small to matter.
